faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Answers to the most common questions parents ask about our educational services

items.question: Can I request a different tutor if needed?
items.answer: Absolutely. If you feel the assigned tutor is not the right fit for your child, you can request a replacement at any time. We'll match you with another qualified tutor to ensure the best learning experience.

items.question: Can I reschedule or cancel a lesson?
items.answer: Yes. You can reschedule or cancel your lesson in accordance with our scheduling policy, giving you the flexibility to adapt to your family's needs.

items.question: What happens after I book a trial lesson?
items.answer: Once your request is submitted, our team will contact you via WhatsApp or email to confirm your details, recommend the most suitable tutor, and schedule your trial lesson at a convenient time.

items.question: Do you offer a money-back guarantee?
items.answer: Yes. We stand behind the quality of our educational services and offer a money-back guarantee under our terms and conditions to ensure complete confidence and satisfaction.

faq.supportText: Reach out to us directly and we'll respond within a few hours. Our team is ready to help.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.subheading: If you have questions about your child's level or want to start with an assessment session, leave your details in the form and we'll reach out soon. The Mustafa Academy team is ready to answer every question and guide you to the right plan for your child, step by step.
